propositions: The tickets store contains 561 pre-existing fsck findings: 550 SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, 10 ORPHAN_EVENT (all AUTO-RECOVER LINK events across 9 tickets), and 1 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit record; repair must reduce repairable findings to zero while retaining the four intentional resolved-fork audit records.

The stale-channel repair path must be exposed as a narrow --only=stale-channel selector through rebar fsck --repair that refuses tickets with concurrent SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT or ORPHAN_EVENT findings and operates through the existing batched, pre-tagged, commit-and-push path.

The repair must run in deterministic order: first AUTO-RECOVER orphan repair in batches, then stale-channel-only repair in resumable batches with --limit=200, with every batch requiring successful commit and push before proceeding to the next batch.
Each batch operation must be reversible via off-repo bundle rollback with exact force-with-lease semantics, preserving the pre-repair tip and diagnostic manifest for abort scenarios.

The safety tooling (CLI selector, mixed-fault refusal, dry-run immutability, limit resumption) must land through Gerrit review with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before any live quiet-window execution against the authoritative tickets store.
